attributes.title: APsA 2027 National Meeting
attributes.credits_text: 36.5 AMA PRA Cat 1 · 36.5 AAPA Cat 1 · 36.5 ANCC CH · 36.5 ACPE · APA CE · ASWB ACE · NBCC
attributes.summary:
The American Psychoanalytic Association's 2027 National Meeting runs Tuesday, February 2 to Friday, February 5, 2027, at the Mayflower Hotel in Washington, DC, with administrative meetings on February 1. APsA is taking applications for the poster session. Dr. Nicolle Zapien will give the 2027 Ticho Memorial Award lecture at the meeting.

APsA is a jointly accredited provider. It offers CME for physicians, CE for psychologists through APA co-sponsorship, ASWB ACE credit for social workers and NBCC credit for counselors (ACEP No. 7556), and it holds New York State approvals for social workers, psychologists and psychoanalysts. Up to 36.5 CME/CE credits are offered for the 2027 meeting, including AMA PRA Category 1, AAPA Category 1 and ANCC contact hours; the CME/CE evaluation is due by March 5, 2027.

Registration opened November 10, 2026. APsA clinical members pay $500 through November 23, $550 through January 8, 2027, and $650 after that; the public professional rate is $700, $750 and $830, and students or residents pay $100, $125 and $150. A single day costs $425. Refunds carry a 20% administrative fee.
